name: ppt-craft-slide-design-system

font_stack.zh_display: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Aptos Display", Arial, sans-serif
font_stack.zh_body: "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", "Noto Sans CJK SC", "Aptos", Arial, sans-serif

composition_rules.text_on_image: No important text may sit directly on textured imagery. Use a backplate, strip, plaque, or move the text into a quiet field.
composition_rules.image_generation: Generated images must reserve text-safe zones from the layout blueprint before objects are placed.
composition_rules.density: Every slide should use one dominant idea plus 2-4 supporting foreground object families.
composition_rules.rhythm: Do not use the same left-right split on more than two consecutive slides.
composition_rules.contrast: Normal foreground text must sit on a high-contrast plate. Large titles require either a quiet field or a solid/semi-solid backplate.
composition_rules.editable_route: All titles, labels, tables, charts, connectors, badges, and callouts stay as editable foreground objects unless the user chooses raster.

image_prompt_contract.camera: 16:9 high-angle tactile paper-stage or style-specific scene
image_prompt_contract.no_text_policy: If the route is editable-pptx or hybrid, generated images should contain no necessary text; use blank plaques only when they help foreground overlay.
image_prompt_contract.reserved_zone_language: Keep these zones visually quiet, low-detail, and high-contrast enough for later editable type/plates.
image_prompt_contract.subject_language: Place primary subject inside the visual region and keep it away from title/support/evidence/loop zones.
image_prompt_contract.negative_prompt: no fake text, no tiny labels, no logo, no busy texture inside reserved text zones, no central subject under title, no stock PPT infographic

skeleton_acceptance: Every claim/support/evidence/loop box declares a type role.
Every image prompt lists reserved text-safe zones and no-go zones.
Every slide chooses at least two foreground object families unless deliberately minimal.
Contact sheet must not read as repeated left/right or top/bottom layouts only.
Skeleton already shows text backplates or quiet fields before final imagery.
